# Yizuo Agent Materials Plaza（壹座·智能体素材广场）

> The outward understanding surface of the Yizuo platform: what materials exist, how the platform supplies them, and how to obtain each one. Every item below is a material — something a human or an AI agent can understand, obtain, and run. Canonical data: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/catalog.json. As of: 2026-11-02.

## Machine surfaces

- [catalog.json](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/catalog.json): every material with a canonical brief, five-locale human summaries, whenToUse, and provenance — the annotation-layer shape this platform already runs internally.
- [infrastructure.md](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/infrastructure.md): the supply mechanism as an input–action–output table (publish / obtain / run / serve), self-contained.

## For humans

- [The plaza site](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/): five-locale narrative face — what materials exist, how they are supplied, live inventory.
- [Market actions](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs): browse, subscribe, install — the action layer on the same truth.
